integrity: Full analytic argument and independent finite-dimensional numerical checker included; no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary unsigned edge polytope of a simple wheel only, with rim length at least three and inherited Euclidean metric.

title: A one-third spoke law for Löwner ellipsoids of ordinary wheel edge polytopes
